svg.title: Flash drum: T and p from two known K values (binary)
svg.text: Flash drum: T and p from two known K values (binary)
Low-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark K = 3.70 on the propane scale (K = y/x = 0.80/0.2162).
Mark K = 0.255 on the n-pentane scale (K = 0.20/0.7838).
Lay a straight edge through the two K marks and extend it to both outer scales.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
